## Follow-ups and risks

- **Frontend CLI/dependency owner:** at the next security/dependency review, reassess node-forge and evaluate a patched CLI path or characterized certificate-stack replacement with integration tests; keep the finding visible meanwhile.
- **Backend dev-tool/dependency owner:** at the next security/dependency review, reassess braces/chokidar/nodemon and characterize any watcher/glob replacement; avoid untrusted deeply nested development glob patterns.
- Offline tests and local builds do **not** verify live Azure authentication, speech/call delivery, callback reachability, or Static Web Apps CLI certificate behavior. Arrange separately authorized sandbox integration checks before claiming these are validated. No live Azure validation was performed.
